goal.en: Say what you own and what exists around you: have / have got, there is / there are, some and any.
goal.ar: أن تعبّر عمّا تملك وعمّا يوجد حولك: have got، وthere is/are، وsome وany.

text.en: I/you/we/they have. He/she/it has. British English often adds “got”: I've got a car = I have a car.
text.ar: نستخدم have مع I/you/we/they وhas مع he/she/it. والإنجليزية البريطانية تضيف got: I've got a car بنفس معنى I have a car.

text.en: English says “I have a headache”, “I am 20 years old”, “I am hungry” — not “I have 20 years” or “I have hunger”.
text.ar: انتبه للفرق عن العربية: نقول I am 20 years old لا I have 20 years، ونقول I am hungry لا I have hunger. لكن نقول I have a headache.

text.en: Use “there is” + singular, “there are” + plural, to say that something exists: There is a bank near here. There are two banks.
text.ar: نستخدم there is مع المفرد وthere are مع الجمع للدلالة على الوجود: هناك بنك قريب / هناك بنكان.

text.en: “There” here does not mean “in that place”. It is a grammar word that introduces existence — like «يوجد» in Arabic.
text.ar: كلمة there هنا ليست ظرف مكان، بل أداة تُستخدم للدلالة على الوجود، وتقابل «يوجد» في العربية.

items.en: There is a problem with the car.
Is there a pharmacy near here?

text.en: Use “some” in positive sentences and “any” in negatives and questions: I have some money. I don't have any money. Do you have any money?
text.ar: نستخدم some في الإثبات، وany في النفي والسؤال: لديّ بعض المال / ليس لديّ مال / هل لديك مال؟

text.en: Use “some” in a question when you offer or request something: Would you like some tea?
text.ar: نستخدم some في السؤال عند العرض أو الطلب: Would you like some tea? لأن المتوقع هو القبول.

questions.sentence: My sister is 24. She ___ 24 years old.

explanation.ar: الإنجليزية تعبّر عن العمر بفعل الكون: She is 24 years old، خلافاً للعربية التي تقول «عمرها ٢٤».

commonMistake.en: “She has 24 years” is a direct translation and sounds wrong in English.
commonMistake.ar: جملة She has 24 years ترجمة حرفية خاطئة.

explanation.en: After doesn't, use the base form: have.
explanation.ar: بعد doesn't يأتي الفعل مجرداً: have.

prompt.en: Rewrite with “have got”: “I have a bicycle.”

explanation.en: have got = have (possession). The short form I've got is the most natural in speech.
explanation.ar: have got تعني have في الملكية، والأشيع في الحديث هو I've got.

questions.sentence: ___ a good restaurant on this street.

explanation.en: Thirty students is plural → there are.
explanation.ar: ثلاثون طالباً جمع، فنستخدم there are.

options: There is a museum in the city.
There are some shops near my house.
It has a museum in the city.

explanation.en: To say something exists, English uses “there is/are”, not “it has”.
explanation.ar: للدلالة على الوجود نستخدم there is/are ولا نقول it has، وهي ترجمة حرفية عن لغات أخرى.

questions.answer: Is there a bank near here

explanation.ar: في السؤال يتقدّم is على there.

explanation.en: “Milk” is uncountable, so it is treated as singular: Is there any milk?
explanation.ar: كلمة milk غير معدودة فتعامل معاملة المفرد: Is there any milk?

questions.sentence: I have ___ questions about the lesson.
We don't have ___ sugar at home.

prompt.en: You are offering tea to a guest. What do you say?
prompt.ar: تعرض الشاي على ضيف. ماذا تقول؟

explanation.en: In offers and requests we use “some”, and “Would you like…?” is the polite form.
explanation.ar: في العرض والطلب نستخدم some، وصيغة Would you like هي المهذبة.

explanation.en: A neutral question uses “any”: Do you have any information? (“some” is only for offers/requests.)
explanation.ar: السؤال المحايد يستخدم any: Do you have any information? أما some فتُستخدم في العرض والطلب.

explanation.en: have/has for possession, don't/doesn't have for the negative, do/does have for questions.
explanation.ar: have/has للملكية، والنفي بـ don't/doesn't have، والسؤال بـ do/does have.

questions.sentence: ___ a table, four chairs and a lamp in the room.

explanation.en: With a list, English matches the verb to the FIRST item: “a table” is singular → there is.
explanation.ar: عند تعداد أشياء، يوافق الفعل أول عنصر في القائمة، و«a table» مفرد فنستخدم there is.

questions.answer: There aren't any buses after midnight

explanation.ar: نفي الوجود مع any واسم جمع.
